data.description: A vampire can crush a humanoid opponent's will as a standard action. Anyone the vampire targets must succeed on a Will save DC %1 or fall instantly under the vampire's influence, as though by a dominate person spell (caster level 12th). The ability has a range of 30 feet. At the GM's discretion, some vampires might be able to affect different creature types with this power.
data.name: Dominate
